name: Taylor Banks "Dr Kaos"
biography: (aka dr.kaos) is a security evangelist and privacy pundit with over 15 years in the information technology industry, the last decade focused almost exclusively on information security and privacy. Since 1998, he has been designing, implementing, teaching and managing secure information systems for Federal Government, US Military, private universities and public companies, from start-ups to Fortune 100. Taylor, is also the PoC for the Atlanta DEF CON Group (DC404), and in 2005 founded "kaos theory security research," creators of the Anonym.OS LiveCD.
